name: log_breastfeeding
description: Log a breastfeeding session that has already finished. segments lists the time spent on each side in order; each segment needs side (left or right), started_at and ended_at. The session's start and end are taken from the earliest segment start and the latest segment end. Use breastfeeding_timer instead for a feed that is happening now.

segments.description: Required. A non-empty array of segments, each like {"side": "left", "started_at": "2026-01-12T08:30:00+02:00", "ended_at": "2026-01-12T08:40:00+02:00"}. side is left or right. Times are ISO 8601; without an offset they are read in the configured timezone. Each segment must end after it starts.
